question:
**A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.**

The scientist said, "We have been working on this project for months."

options.text: The scientist said they had been working on that project for months.
The scientist said they have been working on this project for months.
The scientist said that they were working on that project.
The scientist said that we had worked on this project.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The scientist said they had been working on that project for months.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"We have been working" becomes "they had been working"**
 
 
• Pronoun "we" is changed to "they" to reflect the third person in indirect speech.
 
• Verb "have been working" is changed to "had been working" to match the past perfect continuous tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"this project" becomes "that project"**
 
 
• Demonstrative pronoun "this" is changed to "that" for indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• "The scientist said" remains unchanged as it correctly conveys the reporting clause.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is transformed into indirect speech without quotation marks.
 
• Tense and pronouns are accurately converted to match the context.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The scientist said they had been working on that project for months."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The scientist said they have been working on this project for months."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "have been working" should be "had been working" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The scientist said that they were working on that project."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "were working" is not equivalent to "had been working" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The scientist said that we had worked on this project."
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: "we" should be "they" in indirect speech.
 
• Incorrect tense: "had worked" changes the meaning and does not match the original sentence.
